title: The Molecular Mechanism of Interaction Between SEPALLATA3 and APETALA1 in Arabidopsis thaliana.
authors: Tan, Xiao-Min; Li, Ya-Ru; Song, Man-Ru; Yuan, Ling-Na; Zhao, Zi-Xin; Liu, Ye; Meng, Qi; Huang, Xuan; Ma, Ye-Ye; Xu, Zi-Qin
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过结构预测、蛋白对接及突变实验解析拟南芥MADS转录因子SEP3与AP1的互作机制，并涉及DNA结合能力分析，属于TF-DNA相关蛋白互作建模，但方法以实验为主、AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Flower formation has been a primary focus in botanical research, leading to the identification of multiple factors regulating flowering over the past 30 years. The MADS transcription factors SEPALLATA3 (SEP3) and APETALA1 (AP1) are essential for floral meristem development and organ identity. In Arabidopsis, SEP3 functions as a central integrator, combining MADS proteins into a tetrameric complex, with its interaction with AP1 playing a key role in sepal and petal formation. This research explores AtSEP3 and AtAP1, with particular emphasis on the Leu residue in the K1 subfunctional domain of AtSEP3, which is necessary for their interaction. A predicted structural model of AP1 was used, followed by protein docking with SEP3, which indicated that Leu residues at positions 115 and 116 are critical binding sites. Mutations at these position were examined through yeast two-hybrid assays and other techniques, identifying Leu 116 as a significant site. Subsequent purification and EMSA analysis revealed that mutations in the leucine zipper of SEP3 decreased its DNA binding ability. Observations of transgenic plants showed that disruption of AtSEP3 and AtAP1 interaction resulted in extended vegetative growth, increased size and number of rosette leaves, and modifications in floral structures. This study offers new insights into the interaction mechanism between AP1 and SEP3 during flowering.
abstract_zh: 花器官形成一直是植物学研究的重点，过去30年间已鉴定出多个调控开花的因子。MADS转录因子SEPALLATA3 (SEP3) 和APETALA1 (AP1) 对花分生组织发育和器官身份至关重要。在拟南芥中，SEP3作为核心整合因子，将MADS蛋白组合成四聚体复合物，其与AP1的相互作用在萼片和花瓣形成中起关键作用。本研究探讨了AtSEP3和AtAP1，特别关注AtSEP3 K1亚功能域中的Leu残基，该残基对其相互作用是必需的。使用预测的AP1结构模型，随后与SEP3进行蛋白质对接，表明第115和116位的Leu残基是关键结合位点。通过酵母双杂交试验及其他技术检查了这些位置的突变，确定Leu 116为重要位点。随后的纯化和EMSA分析显示，SEP3亮氨酸拉链中的突变降低了其DNA结合能力。转基因植物观察表明，AtSEP3和AtAP1相互作用的破坏导致营养生长延长、莲座叶大小和数量增加，以及花结构改变。本研究为开花过程中AP1与SEP3之间的相互作用机制提供了新见解。
